notes: The Legion's mason (2026-10-26) and the company's other builders.

motifs: two ways to lay a wall

C.title: Plans
beats: The Consul unrolls a plan for a fort. Tarquin is already pacing it out in the dirt.
There's a fort for this. Yours can follow.

B.title: The same hill
beats: They fortified opposite slopes of the same hill and met at the top, one wall short.
Your corner is off by a stride.
Your corner is off by a regulation.
Then we split the stride and burn the regulation.

A.title: A wall with two names
beats: The wall held through the whole night. Each of them has told the story with the other one in it.
I filed it under both of us.
I carved it under both of us. Stone outlasts paper.

motifs: the door and the wall around it

C.title: Hinges
beats: Rusk inspects Tarquin's new gate the way other men inspect horses.
Good door. It had better be, with you standing in it.

B.title: Built to be held
beats: She built the gate a hand narrower than the plan, so one man could hold it.
I built it for whoever stands there. It's usually you.

A.title: The six-hour gate
beats: Rusk held her gate for six hours. Not a stone moved.
Your door didn't either. Legion work, both of us.

motifs: straight lines and surprises in the dirt

C.title: Under the floor
beats: Tarquin finds a mine under the foundation she has just poured. Twitcher is whistling nearby.
This was not in the plan.
That is what makes it explode.

B.title: Shared ground
beats: They agreed on a line in the dirt. Her side gets walls; his side gets whatever he finds funny.

A.title: The fort that bit
beats: The enemy breached her wall and walked straight into his field. Nobody came through a second time.
But you left me the gap.
